svg.title: URTC-UPDATER architecture
svg.desc: URTC-UPDATER discovers the repositories next to each other from their own manifests, reads the version of each one locally and from GitHub, and installs or updates one project at a time: the candidate is cloned and built in a staging folder, the live installation is replaced only if that build passes, and the previous one is kept. It can also install a program from the signed package of its release. Nothing is ever changed on its own initiative. Tested on a computer against GitHub in an isolated workspace.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Finds the URTC repositories on a PC, compares them with GitHub and installs or updates one only after an explicit confirmation.
